cases.name: create_on_behalf_valid
cases.rule: an agent acting for a person: the whole principal equals the session's

cases.name: user_bytes_look_like_records
cases.rule: record detection counts only a record whose project is the entity

cases.name: create_valid
cases.rule: S1 then the create genesis at 2: P1, no source

cases.name: source_after_save_as
cases.rule: the source keeps its identity; ProjectSavedAs names the copy

cases.name: copy_valid
cases.rule: the copy's genesis follows its own session header whose prev is source.head

cases.name: copy_after_earlier_save_as
cases.rule: a second copy holds the first save-as entry in its prefix

cases.name: effect_under_other_command
cases.rule: (a)(b) an identity effect under another command

cases.name: body_claims_other_project
cases.rule: (a) an event body claiming another project ID than the record

cases.name: second_genesis_same_session
cases.rule: (d) a second genesis in the same session

cases.name: genesis_not_after_session
cases.rule: (d) a genesis that does not directly follow a session header

cases.name: copy_session_prev_not_source_head
cases.rule: (d) a copy genesis whose session header's prev is not source.head

cases.name: source_reidentified
cases.rule: (b) a source-side save-as whose record claims fid-project-identity/1

cases.name: replayed_saved_as
cases.rule: (d) a replayed ProjectSavedAs

cases.name: genesis_other_principal
cases.rule: (a) a genesis whose principal differs from its session header's

cases.name: identity_effect_off_main
cases.rule: (e) an identity effect on a branch other than main

cases.name: identity_with_request
cases.rule: (c) an identity entry also carrying a Request* event

cases.name: promoted_saved_as
cases.rule: (e) an identity entry in a promoted copy

cases.name: corrupt_record_blob
cases.rule: a record blob that does not hash to its output digest

cases.name: two_create_geneses
cases.rule: (d) a second create genesis

cases.name: create_not_first
cases.rule: (d) a create genesis that is not the entry at sequence 2

cases.name: copy_loop
cases.rule: (d) a copy-from loop A to B to A

cases.name: copy_points_at_itself
cases.rule: a copy whose source is itself

cases.name: copy_changes_namespace
cases.rule: (d) a copy with another namespace

cases.name: copy_without_identity
cases.rule: (d) a copy genesis with no prior identity

cases.name: copy_reuses_saved_as_id
cases.rule: (d) a copy genesis claiming the ID an earlier save-as gave a copy

cases.name: saved_as_wrong_project
cases.rule: (a) a save-as entry for another project

cases.name: saved_as_duplicate_copy
cases.rule: (d) a second save-as naming the same copy

cases.name: genesis_off_main
cases.rule: (e) a genesis on another branch than main

cases.name: genesis_promoted
cases.rule: (e) a genesis in a promoted copy

cases.name: create_wrong_major
cases.rule: (a)(b) project.create_project@2 emitting ProjectIdentified

cases.name: genesis_same_kind_other_commitment
cases.rule: (a) same principal kind, another identity commitment

cases.name: genesis_other_on_behalf_of
cases.rule: (a) the genesis acts on behalf of another person than its session

cases.name: args_not_committed
cases.rule: (a) payload args that do not reproduce args_commit

cases.name: args_not_the_commands
cases.rule: (a) committed args that are not create_project's parameters
